# Xclusive Tech

> Xclusive Tech is an award-winning web design, full-stack web development, and digital engineering company based in Kilimani, Nairobi, Kenya. Co-founder of Top Digitally Fit Web Design Firm of the Year (Digitally Fit Awards), with over 120 live, verifiable websites delivered for enterprises, startups, and growing organizations across Kenya.

Xclusive Tech specializes in custom UI/UX design, mobile-first business websites, e-commerce storefronts with automated Daraja M-Pesa API checkout, Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO & AEO), domain registration, and custom web applications. All websites are delivered with 100% source code ownership, zero monthly builder lock-in, and transparent, published pricing in Kenyan Shillings (KES).

## Key Services

- [Custom Web Design & UI/UX](https://www.xclusivetech.co.ke/services#web-design): Mobile-first, bespoke UI/UX prototyped in Figma with fast loading speeds optimized for Kenyan mobile networks (Safaricom, Airtel).
- [E-Commerce & M-Pesa Checkout](https://www.xclusivetech.co.ke/services#ecommerce): Online storefronts integrated with Safaricom Daraja M-Pesa API (STK Push, C2B), card processing, inventory management, and automated PDF receipts.
- [SEO, GEO & AEO Optimisation](https://www.xclusivetech.co.ke/services#seo-services): Structured schema markup (JSON-LD), local SEO for Nairobi and Kiambu, and Generative Engine Optimisation for Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini.
- [Custom Web Applications & SaaS](https://www.xclusivetech.co.ke/services#custom-development): Bespoke web applications, client portals, booking engines, and internal enterprise tools built with scalable full-stack code.
- [Domain Registration & DNS](https://www.xclusivetech.co.ke/services#domain-registration): Official registration of .co.ke, .com, .org, .ke, .africa, and .io domains starting from KES 1,500/year payable via M-Pesa.
- [Social Media Management](https://www.xclusivetech.co.ke/services#social-media-management): Monthly retainer management covering content production, reels, graphic design, and analytics reporting (Starter KES 12,000/mo, Business KES 18,000/mo, Premium KES 25,000/mo).

## Published Pricing in Kenya (KES)

- [Express Sales Landing Page](https://www.xclusivetech.co.ke/pricing): KES 15,000 one-time. Single long-form conversion page with 5 sections, 1-click WhatsApp widget, direct lead intake form, under 1.5s load speed, 3–5 day delivery, and 100% upgrade credit guarantee.
- [Starter Site Package](https://www.xclusivetech.co.ke/pricing): KES 25,000–45,500. Up to 5 pages, custom Figma UI/UX, responsive mobile design, foundational on-page SEO, WhatsApp chat integration, delivered in 2–3 weeks.
- [Business Growth Package](https://www.xclusivetech.co.ke/pricing): KES 49,000–62,000. Up to 15 pages, dynamic CMS blog, advanced SEO schema, Google Analytics & Search Console setup, delivered in 3–5 weeks.
- [E-commerce Pro Package](https://www.xclusivetech.co.ke/pricing): KES 72,000–85,000. Unlimited products, automated Daraja M-Pesa API integration, customer accounts, inventory control, automated order notifications, delivered in 5–7 weeks.
- [Custom Enterprise Solutions](https://www.xclusivetech.co.ke/pricing): From KES 85,000+. Tailored web applications, proprietary portals, REST APIs, and role-based access control (RBAC).
- [Website Maintenance & Care](https://www.xclusivetech.co.ke/pricing): Ongoing support, cloud backups, security patching, and content updates from KES 2,000/month.
